history.name: the cuban mish didn't get
history.description: pressed cuban bread, roast pork, ham, swiss, pickles, yellow mustard. the sandwich he orbited five restaurants to avoid.

history.name: katsu sando
history.description: thick-cut tonkatsu between milk bread. bullseye sauce. shredded cabbage. the kind of sandwich that holds you after a long day of being called a chud.

history.name: grilled cheese
history.description: sourdough, sharp cheddar, butter. nothing else. the sandwich you make when thinking is done for the day.

history.name: egg sandwich
history.description: soft scrambled egg on toasted white bread. salt, pepper, nothing else. the third sandwich. the one you eat sitting on the counter because standing is a commitment.

history.name: spite pbj
history.description: the smallest possible peanut butter and jelly on white bread. made out of protest because he won't stop pressing the button. crust cut off out of pettiness.

history.name: the surrender sandwich
history.description: white bread. single kraft slice. not toasted. not cut. the sandwich equivalent of a plain bagel with plain cream cheese. made for the man who pressed the button five times.

history.name: a pickle in a lettuce leaf
history.description: a single pickle wrapped in a single lettuce leaf. no bread. no heat. no effort. technically a sandwich. made at sandwich number six because he won't stop pressing the button.

history.name: nutella fold
history.description: single bread slice, nutella, folded in half. not a real sandwich. the kind of thing you eat after saying something honest and immediately getting punished for it.

history.name: bánh mì
history.description: crispy baguette, lemongrass pork, pickled daikon and carrot, cilantro, jalapeño, sriracha mayo. the eighth and final sandwich. going out with dignity.

history.name: late-night egg sando
history.description: milk bread crusts off. one fried egg with the yolk still liquid. kewpie mayo, black pepper. late-night hunger food. eaten standing at the counter with the pendant light on.
